overview_description.description: ReNile is an agritech company providing end-to-end solutions for smart farming using the Internet of Things (IoT) and water, air, and soil quality management. The company's monitoring systems offer cutting-edge real-time online analytics that help enhance production efficiency and reduce consumption of our customer farms. ReNile provides a complete solution from monitoring farms, alerting in emergencies, controlling, and providing analytics of the best practice model for farming through the online platform.

about_short_description.short_description: ReNile is an environmental solution and agritech company that offers solutions for smart farming using the IoT in water, air, and soil.

product.name: SeaSense
product.description: An IoT system for real-time monitoring and control of water quality parameters in marine fish farms.

product.name: WiFish
product.description: An IoT solution for real-time monitoring and automated control of water quality in fish farms.

product.name: CMD Full Eye
product.description: A monitoring system for continuous measurement of environmental conditions inside poultry farms.

product.name: OxyOptima
product.description: A dissolved oxygen monitoring device for aquaculture and industrial water applications.

product.name: Water Level Monitoring System
product.description: A system for real-time measurement of water levels in wells, tanks, and irrigation systems.

product.name: pH Water Monitoring System
product.description: A system for real-time monitoring of pH levels in aquaculture and hydroponic water systems.
